name: arduino-board-shell-wizard
description: Provision Arduino Uno Q and Ventuno Q boards over USB/ADB using protected requests and bundled shell tools.

interface.shortDescription: Provision Arduino Q boards over USB/ADB
interface.longDescription: Bundle the provisioning skill and local board tools. Requires local command execution, ADB, and a USB-connected board running the official Linux image. Uses protected request files for credentials and explicit device serials.
defaultPrompt: Check my workspace's Arduino board provisioning readiness without contacting hardware.
Provision my selected Arduino Q board using my protected request file.
